master.prompt:
Create one exceptionally well-crafted, finished 2D character illustration for Flutter Seoul. Use the attached 'DART SIDE' sticker as the PRIMARY drawing-style and Dash-anatomy reference. This is a polished mascot illustration by a professional character designer, NOT an asset atlas, not a generic geometric icon and not a rigid puppet.

One full-body cyan Flutter Dash bird, centered on a plain warm ivory background, with generous clean margins. Character fills about 75% of the square image height. The camera is almost frontal with a very subtle natural three-quarter turn. Dash is singing happily into a small handheld microphone near its beak. Draw the entire pose coherently as one illustration.

MATCH THE REFERENCE'S CRAFT: lively carefully balanced curved silhouettes, confident clean vector-like color shapes, restrained use of dark contour details only where needed, beautifully controlled negative space, complementary cyan-blue and warm brown, a readable ivory belly, a distinct broad blue face mask with soft cheek curves. A compact plump bird with a wide round head/body silhouette, NO elongated egg torso, no human arms/legs. Two bright friendly ROUND black eyes with slim green irises and one tiny white catchlight each, set level and naturally spaced in the face. Eyebrows MUST NOT angle into an angry V. The brown bird beak must be tapered and recognizably three-dimensional through TWO FLAT SHAPES: a small curved upper beak and an open lower beak with a warm cheerful expression. NO diamond lozenge beak, no duck lips, no humanoid mouth. Short layered blue feather wings, each with three carefully shaped rounded feather tips, NOT gloves, fingers, spikes or clip-art hand fans. Very short brown bird legs and neatly articulated little toes support the weight; tiny asymmetry in stance gives life. A compact two-feather cyan crest.

COSTUME: elegant small Korean hanbok fitted to the BIRD. Deep midnight-indigo short outer vest with two well-cut front panels, ivory collar and visible ivory belly, a refined coral goreum ribbon tied just below the beak, small jade norigae hanging at one side. Cloth follows the round belly subtly; a few intentional flat shadow shapes define overlap and seams. Not a huge X collar, not a printed oval torso, no overwhelming ornament, no sleeves that imply human arms. NO sunglasses for this hanbok variation. No hat, helmet, cape, lightsaber or text.

POSE: One SHORT wing curves inward to hold the microphone handle against the chest, showing actual contact at the grip; silver mesh microphone head sits just to one side of the open beak, never covering the eye. The other wing opens in a relaxed rhythmic gesture. Friendly confident performer with a slight lean, feet grounded. The microphone is small and distinct, handle charcoal and head silver. Two tiny teal/coral music-note accents may sit beside the silhouette.

ART DIRECTION: Premium conference merchandise/sticker character, as strong and visually coherent as the reference. Flat illustrated color with at most one purposeful cel-shadow tone per surface. No gradients, fuzzy edges, painterly texture, noise, bevels, glossy plastic, ray-traced shading, thick dark outlines around everything, or flat lifeless circles pasted together. Avoid outlined kiddie-cartoon clipart. Finish clean, expressive, warm and exceptionally charming. NO labels, typography, watermark, framing or drop shadow. Plain ivory background, not transparency checkerboard.

poses.prompt:
Create a production animation POSE SHEET of the EXACT SAME polished 2D Flutter Dash character as the reference. Preserve the quality of the finished reference: coherent illustration, friendly plump bird, expressive round head, broad blue face mask, ivory lower face/belly, short rounded FEATHER wings, very short brown legs and articulated bird toes. Same fine line accents and deliberate cel shadow shapes, same crafted color and curve quality. Do NOT simplify to pasted circles or crude clipart. Do NOT generate separate body parts.
Keep EXACTLY the reference indigo hanbok, ivory collar and belly, coral goreum, jade norigae. Keep friendly visible round eyes, NO sunglasses, compact cyan feather crest.
Landscape canvas, exactly THREE complete full-body illustrations side by side in THREE EQUAL COLUMNS. Transparent background, no grid, no text, no frame, no cast shadows, no particles or music notes. Same character body HEIGHT, head size and foot baseline in ALL THREE; generous transparent margins and clear gaps. Each whole pose stays inside its own column. Character about 70% of total canvas height, tallest hat/crest and toes never clipped.
LEFT: neutral friendly greeting, front view, small closed curved brown BIRD beak (NOT a diamond), one short feather wing lifted in a relaxed hello, other short wing at side; NO microphone or other prop.
CENTER: preserve the reference's natural SINGING pose and open tapered bird beak, one short wing grips a compact HANDHELD microphone near but not obscuring beak, other feather wing makes an easy outward gesture. One coherent illustration with mic in genuine contact. No separate effects.
RIGHT: the same bird in near SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, holding a compact RED MEGAPHONE. Narrow black mouthpiece at its beak, horn opens toward RIGHT, wing wraps handle below rear body. Megaphone viewed in true side profile, NOT facing camera. Feet beneath torso naturally; same body height as other poses. No sound waves (added in animation).
Show ALL complete figures. Three poses in ONE ROW, NOT three rows. Keep the reference's professional friendly character design, smooth clean curves, beautiful expressive bird proportions. This is finished illustration artwork, no toy 3D, no heavy all-around outlines, no transparent debris or glow. Transparent alpha outside shapes.
